module_summary: Five-state linear FSM that after synchronous reset steps B0..B3 to Done, decoding shift_ena high for exactly four cycles.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit state register counting B0-B3 then sticking in Done; decodes shift_ena.

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: FSM-decoded enable for external shift register, high in states B0-B3 only.

groups.name: shift_enable_fsm
groups.description: Linear four-step FSM with next-state logic producing four-cycle shift enable after reset.
